✦ Our Story

Crafted for the Modern Woman

Belle Aura was founded on a simple belief — that every woman deserves to feel radiant, confident, and beautiful in her own skin.

✦ Who We Are

A Luxury Beauty Destination

Founded in 2020, Belle Aura has grown from a small boutique into Pakistan's premier luxury cosmetics destination. We believe beauty is not just about appearance — it's a feeling, a confidence that radiates from within.

Every product we carry is rigorously tested, thoughtfully selected, and held to the highest standards of quality. From globally celebrated brands to emerging luxury houses, our collection represents the finest in modern beauty.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about shopping with Belle Aura

Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 1, 2025

1. Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, phone number, postal address, and payment information when you create an account, make a purchase, or communicate with us.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to process transactions, send transactional and promotional emails, improve our services, and comply with legal obligations. We never sell your personal information to third parties.

3. Cookies

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to provide a personalized experience, analyze usage, and assist in our marketing efforts. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

4. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. All payment information is processed through SSL-encrypted connections and we never store complete card numbers.

5. Contact Us

For privacy-related questions, contact us at privacy@belleaura.pk or write to 14 Jinnah Avenue, Blue Area, Islamabad.

Terms of Service

Last updated: January 1, 2025

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing and using Belle Aura's website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations.

2. Orders & Payments

All orders are subject to availability. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel orders. Payment must be received in full before dispatch. Prices are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) unless stated otherwise.

3. Returns & Refunds

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unused, unopened products in original packaging. Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days. Certain items such as opened cosmetics are non-returnable for hygiene reasons.

4. Intellectual Property

All content on this website, including text, images, logos, and design, is the property of Belle Aura and is protected by copyright law.
